game.title: SHIBA DASH!! お散歩グランプリ
game.license: 制作：AMIX｜トミナガハルキ/ライセンス
game.pitch: Your Shiba runs on its own. You only steer. Coins are collected by the owner dragged on the leash, so every corner is a choice between the racing line and swinging the human into pickups. Four dogs, six courses, three difficulties, optional 2–4 player WebRTC races.
game.controls: ← → or A/D or on-screen arrows: steer (dog auto-runs). Space / Coin Dash button: spend a stored dash (15 coins = 1 dash, max 2). P or Esc: pause. Touch arrows on mobile.
howToPlay: Steer with ◀▶ / arrow keys. The dog runs automatically.
Only the dragged owner collects coins — plan the leash swing.
Cyan panels trigger SHIBA DASH acceleration.
Floating sneakers freeze the owner and slam the brakes; wait to recover.
A wooden stick in the mouth widens and blocks dogs behind you.
Beat 7 AI rivals. 幼柴/若柴 = 3 laps, 厳柴 = 5 laps.
フレンドと対戦: invite URL, 2–4 players over WebRTC (PeerJS signaling).

crazygamesFormPaste.title: SHIBA DASH!! Walking Grand Prix
crazygamesFormPaste.shortDescription: Steer an auto-running Shiba Inu. Coins are caught by the owner bouncing on the leash.
crazygamesFormPaste.longDescription: SHIBA DASH!! is a 3D browser racer where the dog always sprints and you only steer. The owner trailing on the leash is the one who collects coins, so swinging wide on corners is a resource play, not a mistake. Pick Aka / Kuro / Shiro / Goma Shiba, race six courses (day city, sunset, rain, rooftops, river paddle, SHIVA 2049), and beat seven AI rivals. Easy and normal are 3 laps; hard is 5. Cyan panels are SHIBA DASH boosts, sneakers slam the brakes, sticks block dogs behind you. Optional 2–4 player races via invite URL (WebRTC).
crazygamesFormPaste.instructions: Arrow keys or A/D: steer. Space: Coin Dash. P / Esc: pause. On-screen arrows on touch. Dog runs automatically.
